newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-HINGIS FLOORS SELES TO REACH FRENCH FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS FLOORS SELES TO REACH FRENCH FINAL.

text.p: World number one Martina Hingis moved closer to her first French Open title with a hard-fought 6-7 7-5 6-4 semifinal victory over Monica Seles at Roland Garros on Thursday.

The 16-year-old Swiss player, bidding to emulate Seles who was barely two months younger when she won the first of her three French titles in 1990, lost the first set tie-break 7-2 but kept her cool to record her fourth win in four meetings with her opponent.

The remarkable Hingis has now won 37 consecutive matches this year. The only women's player in Open era history to have started a year better is Steffi Graf, who still leads the way with 45 successive wins in 1987.
Hingis will play either South Africa's Amanda Coetzer or Croatia's Iva Majoli in Saturday's final.
